visual_checks.identity: Djokovic verified visually, consistent burgundy Lacoste shirt in source video
visual_checks.eyes: both visibly open and in focus
visual_checks.angle: three-quarter toward camera, about 30–40 degrees; preferred over ATYF... stronger side profile
visual_checks.occlusion: raised hand next to eyebrow, does not occlude pupils or central face
visual_checks.framing: upper body and racket present, not face-only; 3:4 cover crop may clip left racket rim, so actual template preview still needs checking
visual_checks.emotion: alert / reacting; matches unexpected ending better than generic trophy image

searches.result: No Oct 5 Djokovic/Medvedev photos in fetched page; named Djokovic photos are Oct 4 quarterfinal versus Zverev; do not use historical match.
Current lead Djokovic article describes October 4 quarterfinal, not this semifinal.
web open unavailable; not proof of no photo.
Multiple exact-match Reuters captions in search; AS downloadable version 1211x828 and hand partly across central face, less suitable than AP original.
Two exact-match large originals 6238x4159 and 6985x4656 from News4JAX; WVNews versions 1763x1175. AP first original selected.

notes: Photos are independently confirmed same match by embedded IPTC. No frame exception or low-resolution exception needed. Top of head is high in original; preview title/face overlap before using. Do not imply licensing cleared.
